basis: Reference line PCE = 60 (Goljan, Fridrich and Filler 2009), fixed in advance and then measured on the SensorTrace VISION subset evaluation (13 smartphones from 2011-2016, camera-original JPEGs at native resolution, 40 flat-field reference images per device). Observed at this threshold: 0 false matches in 3,680 different-device comparisons (95% upper bound 0.10%), including 0 in 560 same-model comparisons (95% upper bound 0.66%); 7 misses in 520 same-device comparisons (1.3%, 95% interval 0.5-2.8%), all from one device model outside the scope below. The non-match line of 10 is an engineering choice: 99.4% of different-device comparisons and 1.3% of same-device comparisons fell at or below it. Valid only for the listed models under comparable conditions; trials sharing a device are not independent, so the intervals are optimistic.
